Ascorbic acid injection in measured doses for retail/therapeutic use is a medicament of heading 3004. Subheading 3004.50 covers other medicaments containing vitamins or derivatives, put up in measured doses. The statistical suffix 3004.50.5020 is not certain, but the HTSUS structure is 3004.50.10 (containing provitamins/vitamins, for... ), 3004.50.50 (other), and I recall 3004.50.5010 for "Ascorbic acid (vitamin C)". Under 3004.50.50, the statistical suffixes are 10 (Put up for retail sale? ...). I am not certain, but I'll go with 3004.50.5000 since the suffix is unclear.

Checking further: 3004.50.10 is "Containing vitamins A, B1, B2, B6, B12, C, etc." Actually, I recall 3004.50.10 = "Medicaments containing provitamins, vitamins... : Containing combinations in any proportion..." Hmm. I recall 3004.50.20 = "Other: Containing... 3004.50.50 = Other." Since a single vitamin C product is not a combination, 3004.50.50 is plausible, with suffix 00 or 90.

I'll choose 3004.50.5000.
